title.narrative: Infrastructure Support to Strengthen Capacity Building of Forensic Drug Analysis in the Criminal Justice System in Sri Lanka

description.narrative: Infrastructure Support to Strengthen Capacity Building of Forensic Drug Analysis in the Criminal Justice System in Sri Lanka. With the overarching objective to enhance Government Analyst's Department’s timely capacity to analyse Narcotic Drugs to provide reliable reports requested by law enforcement in Sri Lanka, UNOPS scope is to design and remodel two (2) laboratories and one (1) server room at the Government Analyst's Department, Colombo \n
